feedback: Of 240 sampled frames, 49 contain filtered character candidates and 16 contain continuously confirmed targets.
Mean distance to the upper-box anchor is 118.5 pixels. Review vertical and horizontal aim offsets.
Box alignment is 6.2% in frames with confirmed targets; this is not hit accuracy.
1 eligible acquisition events; median proxy 100 ms. This is not human reaction time.
Green crosshair localization failed in 23 / 240 frames; screen center was used.
limitations: The generic COCO person detector identifies character candidates, without distinguishing enemies, teammates, bodies, or weapon false positives. It has not been fine-tuned on CS2.
The sample is spectator footage with x-ray. The algorithm may detect occluded outlines that the player cannot see. Detection onset does not establish enemy visibility.
The anchor is fixed at 15% down the box, a geometric approximation rather than head detection. Box alignment is not hit accuracy.
Acquisition delay is a proxy from first continuous detection to crosshair entry, not human reaction time. Missing frames, missed detections, or tracking gaps end the event.
HSV searches only for small green components near screen center. Failure falls back to center and records the source. Other colors, resolutions, and spectator layouts may require calibration.
ROI and hand filters use a layout preset for this recording and may discard edge or occluded characters. Different HUD layouts require recalibration.
Shots, damage, kills, and game state are not detected. No accuracy evaluation against manual ground truth is available.
Timestamps use frame index and container-average FPS. Constant-frame-rate input is recommended; variable-frame-rate recordings may introduce timing error.

methodology.detector: yolo11n.pt / class 0 person; local weights (COCO-compatible class mapping required)
methodology.crosshair: Center-localized green HSV component, center fallback flagged
methodology.tracking: Greedy IoU/distance association; 3 consecutive sampled observations to confirm; gap closes acquisition episode
methodology.anchor: bbox top + 0.15 * height (geometric proxy, not anatomical head)
methodology.alignment_denominator: Frames with at least one currently confirmed track
methodology.acquisition_denominator: Confirmed uninterrupted encounters that began unaligned and later aligned

provenance.preparation: First 24 seconds, resized to1280x720, resampled to30 FPS, H264, audio omitted
